entries.message: Header theme toggle cut-off suppression: to prevent clipping on mobile and narrow viewports, the theme toggle button is suppressed from the header on screens <= 520px and via dynamic overflow collision detection, while remaining 100% accessible to all users (guest and logged-in) inside the settings dropdown

Header theme toggle: for non-logged-in (guest) users, the light/dark mode toggle button is now positioned on the right-hand side of the header across all viewports (mobile and desktop) so theme switching is directly accessible without requiring account settings

Dual-review hardening: viewport user-zoom enabled (WCAG 1.4.4), focus-visible outlines on all media transport & reorder controls (WCAG 2.4.7), audio scrubber accessible slider with keyboard seeking, theme toggle icon FOUT eliminated (dark default), playlist URL deep-linking for third-party recipients with dynamic server load and Copy Link / Share buttons

Public playlist filters rebuilt from scratch: persistent filter bar with live Teacher/Venue/Topic dropdowns, unlimited multi-select tokens, results-only updates so picks never wipe inputs, focus and draft preserved

Public playlist filters are now Advanced-style live dropdowns: type in Teacher/Venue/Topic to see matching suggestions, pick multiple as in-box tokens plus Active Filters pills; Enter picks first match, Backspace removes last, focus preserved across searches
Playlist search scope controls: 3 checkboxes for Title & Tags (default on), Description (default on), and Shiurim therein (default off) with database subquery matching
Playlist search multi-select filter cards: add multiple teachers, venues, and topics as dismissible chips with X buttons and Clear All
Save for later playlist rename and vertical icon alignment across playlist pills
Add-to-playlist multi-select enhancements: staged state management, live counter ticks (+1 / -1), explicit Save Changes commitment button, and self-saving author guard on public playlists
Enhanced playlist creation modal: 16-icon emoji picker, multiline description, typeahead taxonomy tags (max 5), and duplicate playlist name prevention
Playlist sorting & ordering controls: multi-criteria sorting (Recently Added, Shiur Date Newest/Oldest, Last Listened), manual reordering controls, and HTML5 drag-and-drop
Playlists tab restructuring: segmented top control (My Playlists vs Public Playlists), sticky frozen top row for library lists, and subscribed/read-only highlighting
Play queue UX: idempotent single-click close and circular icon prompt
Plain gear icon enforced (all letter initials purged), hero slideshow text & dual-mode contrast restored with full-width bottom overlay
Public playlist saving choice: Subscribe / Follow (read-only live sync) vs Make an Editable Copy, plus D1 database backup guide
Plain gear avatar default, dropdown tab switching (My Playlists & Queue), light mode playlist card contrast & borders, theme-adaptive hero slideshow contrast (light & dark)
